_note: suspend-picks-a-pause-reason 4.1: a pause reason can carry the number of days the applicant is usually given (`defaultDays`); the Opschorten form fills Dagen with it when the reason is picked, through nextcloud-vue `prefillFrom`. Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.32.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema (1.30.0 and 1.31.0 are taken by other queued fragments; the merger keeps the highest version, register-version-is-the-highest).

defaultDays.title: Default days
defaultDays.description: How many days the applicant is usually given for this reason. The Opschorten form fills it in when the reason is picked; the handler can change it.
